eyebrow: A Vector That Only Gets Scaled

steps.label: Most vectors get rotated AND scaled by a matrix
Av = lambda v for some scalar lambda
steps.sub: Same direction out as in — just scaled by lambda, the eigenvalue

steps.label: lambda can be real, complex, negative, or zero
steps.sub: Nothing in the definition restricts it

caption: (1,0) comes back scaled, same direction. (1,1) comes back pointing a genuinely different way — that contrast is the whole definition.

steps.label: An n x n matrix has at most n such special directions
steps.sub: Along them, the matrix's action collapses to 'multiply by one number'

steps.label: That number is a property of the matrix itself
steps.sub: Not of any particular vector you happened to choose

steps.label: In quantum computing, those are literally a measurement's return values
steps.sub: No extra magic — just this linear-algebra idea, applied

subtitle: Finding them from scratch, using the Pauli-Z matrix.
